# Amos Chapter 6 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 335v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/AMO_006_page_001.jpg

---

**6:1** Woe [hoi] to-those-who-are-at-ease [sha'anannim] in-Tsiyon [Zion] and-those-who-trust [ha-botchim] in-the-mountain of-Shomron [Samaria] — the-notable [nequvei] [ones] of-the-first [re'shit] of-the-nations [ha-goyim], and-the-house of-Yisra'el comes [u-va'u] to-them.

**6:4** Those-who-lie [ha-shokevim] on beds [mittot] of-ivory [shen] and-stretch-out [u-seruchim] on their-couches [arsotam], and-eat [ve-okhelim] lambs [karim] from the-flock [mi-tson] and-calves [va-agalim] from-the-midst [mi-tokh] of-the-stall [marbeq].

**6:5** Those-who-improvise [ha-portim] to the-sound [al-pi] of-the-harp [ha-navel]; like-David they-invent [chashevu] for-themselves instruments [kelei] of-song [shir].

**6:6** Those-who-drink [ha-shotim] from-bowls [be-mizraqei] of-wine [yayin], and-with-the-best [re'shit] of-oils [shemannim] they-anoint [yimshakhu]; but-they-are-not sickened [lo nechl'u] over the-ruin [shever] of-Yosef [Joseph].

**6:7** Therefore now they-will-go-into-exile [yiglu] at-the-head [be-rosh] of-the-exiles [golim], and-the-revelry [mirzach] of-the-sprawlers [seruchim] will-depart [vesar].

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.4-6 — The luxuries:** Ivory beds, choice meats, improvised music, bowls of wine, finest perfumes — Amos catalogs the lifestyle of Samaria's elite with devastating precision. Archaeological finds at Samaria (ivory carvings, fine pottery) confirm this luxury.

**v.5 — "like David":** The comparison to David — who composed psalms — is probably ironic. These revelers fancy themselves artists while their society collapses.

**v.6 — "not grieved over the ruin of Joseph":** The central accusation: they are indifferent to the suffering of their own people. The Hebrew *lo nechl'u* means they are not *sickened* — it is a visceral word for physical revulsion at moral failure.

*— EMET*
